messages.subject: Re: GGobi libxml2-2.dll is missing
messages.body_plain:
I have successfully resolved the problem:

1. Install ggobi from http://www.ggobi.org/downloads/
2. Make sure that its location (which includes the missing xml library) got added to the search path
3. Restart R.
